title: Zwei Bolzen für die Freiheit
sceneDescription: Roger, an adult man of average build with brown wavy hair in a shoulder-length ponytail and clean-shaven soft features, kneels in the far left background of the vast grey cobblestone Marktplatz Altdorf, his body angled to face right across the open square. He wears a deep forest green felt hat with a small grey feather, an earth-brown rough-woven wool tunic with a laced neckline, dark olive wool trousers, tall dark brown leather boots, and a dark tawny sleeveless leather jerkin over the tunic; black-framed glasses sit on his straight-nosed face with rounded tip and medium cheekbones. His arms are raised and extended forward as he holds Rogers Armbrust — a forearm-length wooden crossbow with two short curved bow limbs mounted perpendicular to the stock in a T-shape, a taut gut bowstring, and a wooden bolt with grey fletching resting in the groove along the stock — horizontal and level, aimed diagonally across the square toward the far right. His left eye closes in concentration as he sights down the weapon. In the far right background, a slim young school-age boy, Lukas, stands motionless against a bare tree, his short straight brown hair and brown eyes fixed forward, his rounded child features frozen in a moment of stillness. He wears a simple off-white linen tunic with a slightly rounded neckline, brown rough-woven wool trousers to the calf, simple dark brown leather shoes with a single strap, and a thin brown rope belt knotted at the front — and balanced atop his head sits Der Apfel, a fist-sized round apple with smooth bright red skin and a short brown stem. Lukas is roughly a sixth the size of Roger across the vast distance, a small figure dwarfed by the empty cobblestone expanse between them. The midground on both flanks is lined with a dense crowd of medieval villagers in ochre, brown, and rust tunics, pressed back from the open square in silence. Among them on the right flank, three small named figures are visible: Sophie, a young teen girl with light brown wavy shoulder-length hair, light freckles on her nose and cheeks, and brown eyes, wears a sage green linen overdress with a wide square neckline falling to mid-shin and soft flat brown leather shoes; Manuel, a teenage boy with dark brown wavy tousled hair, brown eyes, and lean teenage proportions, wears a mid-blue rough-woven linen tunic with wide sleeves, dark grey wool trousers, and flat dark brown leather shoes; and Verena, an elderly woman with silver straight chin-length hair with bangs, kind brown eyes behind glasses, and soft facial features, wears a dark olive green heavy wool tunic with long sleeves and a round neckline falling to the ankle and flat soft dark brown leather shoes, with a coarse undyed natural wool outer cloak draped over her shoulders. All three hold their breath in silence, Sophie's jaw clenched slightly. The flat overcast pale grey sky of November stretches unbroken across the full upper band of the frame, casting a cool diffuse light across the entire square.
text: Ein Soldat stellte Lukas weit weg an einen Baum am Rand des Platzes und legte ihm einen Apfel auf den Kopf. Lukas schluckte. Er dachte an Eli, seinen Kuschelelefanten, der zu Hause auf seinem Bett wartete. Dann dachte er an seinen Vater.
